test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

Statements:

All lions are cheetahs.

Some cheetahs are tigers.

Conclusions:

(I) Some tigers are not cheetahs.

(II) All cheetahs are lions.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/55bff50badd319d24c6620c1e313e7e5f42e614d22c997c8dcfbc21cc1d93cf6.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some tigers are not cheetahs → False (As, Some cheetahs are tigers. so, Some tigers are not cheetahs can be a possibility but not definite)

(II) All cheetahs are lions → False (As, All lions are cheetahs. so, All cheetahs are lions can be a possibility but not definite)

Thus, Neither conclusion I nor II follows.
